title: Fix broken category icons by generating local SVGs with fallback handling

requirements.text: Add local SVG icon assets for every homepage category and every "Local Skilled Workers" subcategory under frontend/public/assets/generated, and ensure no category/subcategory icon uses any external URL.

quotes:
Fix broken images.

Generate local SVG icons for every category and subcategory.
Do not use external URLs.

acceptanceCriteria: All category and subcategory icons used by the UI resolve to local paths under /assets/generated/ and do not reference any external URL.
All new icon files are SVGs and are committed as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
The app builds successfully and category/subcategory icons render without broken image placeholders in the browser.

requirements.text: Update the category and subcategory icon references in the frontend to use the new local SVG icon filenames (replacing current .png references), including icons defined in frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx and frontend/src/config/localSkilledWorkers.ts.

quotes:
Fix broken images.

Generate local SVG icons for every category and subcategory.

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx category icon paths reference .svg files under /assets/generated/ (not .png).
frontend/src/config/localSkilledWorkers.ts subcategory icon paths reference .svg files under /assets/generated/ (not .png).
No remaining references to the old icon .png filenames are required for correct rendering of category/subcategory icons.

requirements.text: Implement a default fallback icon behavior for category and subcategory icons: if an icon path is missing, empty, or fails to load, render a local fallback SVG icon instead of hiding the image or leaving it broken.

quotes: If icon missing show default fallback icon.

acceptanceCriteria: On the homepage category grid, when an icon fails to load, the UI displays the fallback icon (the icon is not hidden).
On the Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid, when an icon fails to load, the UI displays the fallback icon.
Fallback uses a local SVG file under /assets/generated/ and does not load from any external URL.
The fallback behavior does not change spacing, sizing, or layout of the existing category/subcategory cards (only the image source changes).

constraints: Do not modify the database or backend state/schema.
Do not modify UI layout (no changes to grid/card structure, spacing, or component placement).
Do not use external image/icon URLs for category or subcategory icons; icons must be local static assets.
nonGoals: Changing worker profile photos or how worker photos are stored/served.
Adding new categories/subcategories or changing taxonomy labels.
Redesigning the homepage/category UI or altering visual layout.
